# Documentation #

## File format ##

The .igs file is a CAD file, in the plain-text IGES format (Initial Graphics Exchange Specification). 

## Abbreviations ## 

RGJF is the name of the author: Richard G.J. Flay  
Lm: length of the model  
Lfs: equivalent length at full scale  
Fr: Froude number  
Eq V f-s: Equivalent velocity at full scale
